title: NatsukiCheatChecker
description: NatsukiCheatChecker - New Checker for your minecraft server!
body:
# NatsukiCheatChecker

A cheat-detection plugin inspired by the tsundere character Natsuki from *Doki Doki Literature Club*!

## 🌸 Support and Contact
- **Discord server:** [https://discord.gg/fuUNsUQ6VW](https://discord.gg/fuUNsUQ6VW)

## 🌸 Features

- **Player detection** with instant freeze
- **Discord integration** with beautiful embedded messages
- **Progress bar** with a timer for both the player and the admin
- **Tsundere style** in all messages
- **Customizable messages** via config.yml

## 📋 Commands

### Main Commands
- `/natcheck <nick> <type>` - Start a player check
- `/natsukecheck <nick> <type>` - Alternative check command
- `/natsukiapprove <nick>` - Approve a check
- `/natsukidecline <nick>` - Decline a check

### Check Types
- `ds` - Check via Discord
- `anidesk` - Check via AniDesk

## 🔧 Configuration

### Permissions
- `natsuki.check` - Use check commands
- `natsuki.approve` - Approve a check
- `natsuki.decline` - Decline a check
- `natsuki.reports` - View and process reports
- `natsuki.report` - Create reports
- `natsuki.*` - All plugin permissions

### Discord integration
Configure the webhook in `config.yml`:

```yaml
discord:
  enabled: true
  webhook-url: “YOUR_WEBHOOK_URL_HERE”
  bot-name: “🌸 Natsuki Bot”
  bot-avatar: “https://i.ibb.co/yn8bHGmJ.png”
```

## 🎮 Reporting System
- `/report <player> <reason>` - Report a player
- `/report list` - Show a list of reports (for admins)
- `/report accept <ID>` - Accept a report
- `/report reject <ID>` - Reject a report
- `/report delete <ID>` - Delete a report

## 📊 Statistics
- `/natsukistats` - Show general statistics
- `/natsukistats top` - Top administrators
- `/natsukistats rate` - Top by check success rate

## 🔧 Plugin Management
- `/natsuki help` - Show help
- `/natsuki reload` - Reload configuration
- `/natsuki webhook status` - Webhook status
- `/natsuki webhook test` - Test webhook

## 📸 Message Examples

### Start of Check
```
🔍 CHECK HAS STARTED!
Admin: AdminName
Player: PlayerName
Check Type: DS

Ahem! N-Natsuki is going to check everything now, baka!
```

### Successful pass
```
✅ CHECK PASSED!
Player: PlayerName
Admin: AdminName
Check type: DS
Time: 45 sec.

I-I’m not exactly thrilled... but he’s clean!
```

### Check Failed
```
❌ CHEATER CAUGHT!
Player: PlayerName
Admin: AdminName
Check Type: DS
Time: 30 sec.

FUCK YOU AND GO TO HELL!
N-Natsuki doesn't tolerate cheaters, you degenerates!
```

## 🎮 How to use

1. **Install the plugin** in the `plugins/` folder
2. **Configure the Discord webhook** in `config.yml`
3. **Grant permissions** to admins
4. **Start the check** with the command `/natcheck <nick> <type>`
5. **The player will be frozen** and see a progress bar
6. **Complete the check** using `/natsukiapprove` or `/natsukidecline`

## ⚙️ Configuration

Main settings in `config.yml`:

```yaml
settings:
  max-check-time: 300        # Max check time (sec)
  freeze-player: true        # Freeze player
  show-progress-bar: true    # Show progress bar
  kick-on-decline: true      # Kick on decline
```

## 🌟 Plugin Features

- **Automatic player freeze** during verification
- **Beautiful embed messages** in Discord
- **Timer** displaying verification time
- **Tsundere dialogues** in the style of Natsuki
- **Automatic kick** upon verification failure
- **Notifications** about the plugin's status in Discord

## 📦 Installation

1. Download the `.jar` file from `build/libs/`
2. Place it in your server's `plugins/` folder
3. Restart the server
4. Configure `config.yml`
5. Enjoy the plugin!~
